title: Map and inspect Automobile HTTP Browsing, Ping and Video Streaming results
affectedSection: Automobile HTTP Browsing, Ping and Video Streaming results
steps: In GIS, open the Automobile layer configuration and choose HTTP Browsing, Ping or Video Streaming under Test type.
Add the selected test type to the map to display its results as selectable points.
Select a point to open its detail dialog and review the test type, result time, location and available network context.
Read Page Load Time for HTTP Browsing, Ping Time for Ping, or Rebuffer Count for Video Streaming.
For HTTP Browsing, use the Error marker and legend to identify failed results; a zero Page Load Time can still be a failure.
screenshotCaptions: The selected HTTP Browsing result opens a detail view with its point identity and context.
The HTTP Browsing detail displays Page Load Time for the selected result.
The Ping detail displays Ping Time for the selected result.
The Video Streaming detail displays Rebuffer Count for the selected result.
The failed HTTP Browsing result appears with the Error marker and Error legend.
reason: Adds instructions for displaying the three Automobile result types as map points, opening their details and reading their test-specific KPIs and HTTP error styling.
